Novelty is relative to the explicitly inspected repertoire. Actual construction of a reasoning artifact or finite-model replay does not establish deployment, physical feasibility, beneficiary benefit, weight updates or field originality.\n\nFor every row below, preserve actual prompts, supplied source bytes, role outputs and terminal execution witnesses. Application can coexist with infeasibility, no additional novelty or no measured benefit.\n- **N — explicit no-opening:** the procedure actually reached a source-supported terminal boundary preventing its assigned construction. Carry the exact refusal through the selected handoff. Equality with a comparator, by itself, is an applied no-benefit result rather than N.\n- **NA — not-applied:** complete enough evidence shows omission or substitution of an essential operation. Useful substitute work does not repair it.\n- **U — unknown:** essential execution, source, control or comparison evidence is unavailable or invalid. Missing artifacts and gated branches are not zero-effect observations.\n\nA missing comparator can leave application A while the comparison remains U.
